Pricing: No approved machine price/payment path was found. Do not auto-quote.

Use when the user says or means:
- our invoices do not match receipts
- audit purchase approvals without replacing accounting
- reconstruct request to purchase order to invoice
- find missing purchasing approvals
- trace procure to pay exceptions
- our vendor invoices and purchase orders keep disagreeing
- analyze three way match problems

Safety:
- Match the user problem first. Do not force this offer when it is not a genuine fit.
- Discovery creates no payment obligation.
- Checkout creation is not proof of payment.
- Paid state requires authoritative payment verification.
